aqu.review:
easy going dude, Sarcastic as L some may find him rude, but tar sense of humour e omon, easy asf questions. No theory questions in quiz and final but some in mid but tao ato simple, question similar difficulty to what is resistor or what is voltage?
Class 20 min deri te shuru kore and 20 min age sesh kore dei.
And porano ato simplified and dumbed down, after every class I was like really? that's it? Eto simple?
Final mid and quiz e literally ek type er circuit beshi pradhonno dei. You see je ghure fire shob either voltage divider or self.
Curving idk kemne ki kore. But amr khetre: ami final e 34/45 answer korsi, paisi 32/45 ar grade A- dise. Amr mid je bhalo hoise tao na. Kemne je A- dilo I have no clue. (Not complaining).

Aqu sir er class miss diben na. Class e ja porabe oitai exam dei. Quiz e class er korano math e diye dei. Mid and final e theory thakeh ekta question e baki gulo math. Ekta question tricky krbe but oitao concept clear thakle easy. Lab e ektae issue j sob lab reports lekha lagbe individually. So aqu sir apnar jonno best hobe jodi regular poralekha korar type er hon. Learning er jonno o uni valo. Also uni curve kore.
